translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Animaalanu peya jami.
Tsenñu Yavé, Moisésnu tsandimi: Faraón' junga ji' keejide, tsejtu tsandide: Yavé, hebreo chachilla' Dios, entsandive: In chachillanu mandyaike' eede inu aawa kure' keewaajinudetsu, tive.
Entsandiñuren eetyu' ne daata daatadishu juntsaa,
Yavé ya' pudeechi, jeenbaasha pumu ñu' animaalanu tsamantsaa peya eenu tsuve, tsenñu naa kawallu, naa buru, naa kameyu, naa wagaa, naa uveja, naa chibu juula bain tsamantsai peyanu detsuve.
Tsaaren Yavé, Israel chachilla' animaalanuya, Egipto chachilla' animaalanu naakenu ju'ba tsanguen jutyuve, tsenñu Israel chachillachiya ma animaaba peyan dejutyuve, timi.
Tsejtu Yavé naamaa tsanguenu ju'ba waintu: Iya, Yavé, ayu malunaa entsa tsanguenu tsuyu, tive, timi.
Tsejtu ayunchi Yavé tsanguiñu kumuinchi Egipto chulla' animaalaya peyadundala, tsenñuren Israel chachilla' animaalaya maliba peyaindyula.
Tsenñu faraón, Israel chachilla' junga ji' keenu eetu, uwain naa ma animaaba peyaindetyuñuba mijami. Tsejturen faraón meenguityu jutu, Israel chachillanu erei'mi.
Bishpee peya
Tsenñu Yavé, Moisésnu bain, Aarónnu bain entsandimi: Ñinbelesha ji', tyaapachi ñijuingui kalare', faraón' ajuusha jitu, Moisés kai'sha kelaakisa.
Tsenmala juntsa ñijuingui ñiyuyui tiya', kumuinchi Egiptosha tsaa dejeke' jiinu tsuve, tsejtu kumuinchi Egiptonu chumu chachillanu bain, naa yala' animaalanu bain bishpee tene iwaakenu tsuve, timi.
Tsenñu Moisés, Aarónba ñinbeesha ñijuingui dekatu, faraón' junga jila. Tsejtu Moisés juntsa ñijuingui kai'sha tya'kelaanmalan, naa chachilla bain, naa animaala bain, tsaa bishpee tene iila.
Tsejtu entsa bijeenuya mirukula Moisésnu vej vej kikai'la yai bain kumuinchi Egipto' chulla naadejuñu bain juntsa deju' bishpee tene jude' mitya.
Tsaaren Yavé faraónnu meedin jutyungue tiwaañu, naa Moisésnu bain, naa Aarónnu bain meengui'mi, matyu Yavé, Moisésnu naajunu tsuve timuwaañuba juntsaatu.
Isha puka tene paijmi.
Tsenñu Yavé Moisésnu tsandimi: Ayu dishkepenene kujpa', faraón' junga jitu, entsandide: Yavé, hebreo chachilla' Dios entsandive: In chachillanu mandyaike' eede, yala inu aawa kure' keewaanudetsu,

matyu tsangui'shu juntsaa, umaa entsa bijeenuya kumuinchi peya, naa ñunu bain, naa ñu' bale chachillanu bain, naa ñu' chachillanu bain de-eekenu tsuyu, tsenmalaa ñu mijanutsu, naa muba veelaya entsa tunu iya tsaa dechui'ñuba.
Iya ñunu bain, naa ñu' chachillanu bain in tyaapa uske' tsamantsaa peya ere' firu keñuya yumaa millaichu deeve.
Tsaanuren ñunu
in pudee katasa tenñaa, tsenmin kumuinchi entsa tunu iya naaju'ba keemijakutinu tenñu' mityaa, chaiba chujti' tanayu.
Naa tsaañu bain, ñuya chaiba meenguindyu', in chachillanu me-erendyuve.
Tsaaren ayuya entsa uwatala isha puka tene shuwa pure' jaiñungue pajtekaanu tsuyu, tsenñu Egipto tusha naa-uwanuba tsaa ityu'ba, tsaa i' puinu tsuve.

Tsa' mitya kumuinchi ñu' animaalanu jeenbaasha pumulanuya tiba innatyuinsha depukaade, matyu juntsa isha puka kumuinchilanu paijnu tsuve, naa chachillanu bain, naa animaalanu bain, tsejtu avindaa depu', ya juusha putyulanuya detutekenu tsuve, tide, timi.
Tsenñu faraón' bale chachilla mantsalaya Yavé tsandi' wainñu demija' jeetyatu, yaichi manda-i' taawasha kemu chachillanu bain, naa yala' animaalanu bain ya pandainsha tene jeke manbula.
Tsenñuren mantsalaya ka anbudaa tyatu, avindaa ne tsangaala.

Tsenñu Yavé, Moisésnu tsandimi: Ñu' tyaapa selusha usakide, tsenmala kumuinchi Egiptosha isha puka tene shuwa keraaya naa chachillanu bain, naa animaalanu bain, naa Egipto tutala chi chumulanu bain depaijnutsu, timi.
Tsenñu Moisés ya' tyutyan cha'li selusha usakenmalan, Yavé kuidya pakare', pi'kikaakaakemin, isha puka tene tusha shuwa pajten tsanguemi. Tsejtu kumuinchi Egipto tushaya Yavé isha puka depajtekemi.
Tsenñu dyai'mujchi naa isha puka bain, naa kuidya pidya bain isha pukaba buluu pajtya pajtyaila, tsejtu tsamantsa daran depaijtu, Egipto tushaya naa-uwanuba tsaityun umaa tsai' puimi.

Tsejtu juntsa isha pukaren shuwa pajtyan tsaitu, Egipto tu jeenbaasha ti dechuñuba tsaa millangaami: naa chachillanu bain, naa animaalanu bain, naa kumuinchi tape chumulanu bain, naa chi chumulanu bain yala' ali demujkii balikemi.
Tsaaren naa Egipto tu kuraa tsa i' bain, Gosen tusha, Israel chachilla' chuinshaya, naa ma isha pukaba pajtyaindyumi.
Tsenñu faraón Moisésnu bain, Aarónnu bain janu mandanguitu tsandimi: Uwain iya ujcha layu, iyaa in chachillaba kuipa deeyu, Yavéya tiba kuipajtuve.
Tsa' mitya Yavénu, naa kuidyanu bain, naa isha puka pajamunu bain mandyawaade ti' pa'dei; yumaa mika ikandetsuyu, tsenmala iyaa ñullanu umaa daatadityu' me-eenu tsuyu, timi.

Tsenñu Moisés tsandimi: Nei'ba pebulunu malu' miimin, in tyaapa uske' Yavéba kuinda kenu tsuyu. Tsenñu naa isha puka bain manbajtyan jutyuve, tsenmin kuidya bain manban jutyuve, tsenmalaa ñu mijanu tsuve naa entsa tuya Yavéchiñu bain.
Tsaanuren naa ñu bain, naa ñu' bale chachilla bain chaiba Dios Yavénu jelajdetuñuba iya nara miyu, timi.
Tsenñu naa linu vijpala bain, naa sebada vijpala bain, tsaa millai mushala, matyu sebadaya yumaa ñi depuunmala, linuya yumaa llullu dejuularen tsaila.
Tsenñuren trigu, sentenubaya tiba indyula, entsalaya kayu benee seepumu de' mitya.
Tsejtu Moisés, faraónba dekuindake' pebulu kapasha malutu, ya' tyaapa usake' Yavéba kuinda kemi. Tsenmalan kuidya bain, naa isha puka bain mandya', naa shuwa bain maatyui manbimi.
Tsenñu faraón umaa naa shuwa bain, naa isha puka bain manbajatyui tiya', naa kuidya bain manbatyui tiyanmalan, manen ujcha malami, tsejtu ya bain, naa ya' bale chachilla bain meenguindyatyui tiyala.
Tsejtu faraón meenguityu jutu, Israel chachillanu me-eetyumi, matyu Yavé, Moisésnu patu, naajunu tsuve timuwaañuba juntsaatu.

footnotes.text: 9.16 Iya ñunu bain, naa ñu' chachillanu bain in tyaapa uske' tsamantsaa peya ere' firu keñuya yumaa millaichu deeve. 16 Tsaanuren ñunu tityumujchi, entsandinu bain juve: Tsa' mitya challaya in tyaapa uske', ñunu bain, naa ñu' chachillanu bain peya ere' millangaanu tsuyu. 16 Tsaju' ñunu ti' aseetanguikara bain junu juve.
